scenario: BEP 14 local service discovery and discovery regressions
validation_scope: Recorded working tree and local Linux clients only, not a universal compatibility or performance claim.
source_manifest_contents: Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs, src files, and Python interop harnesses
post_run_changes: The LSD harness docstring was corrected to describe IPv6/multiple-address support after the runs; executable code is unchanged. The source manifest and run hashes describe the executed version.
build_note: The IPv6 matrix overlapped cargo test, which rebuilt the same source with workspace test feature unification. Its hybrid daemon's /proc/PID/exe matched workspace_test_binary_sha256. A subsequent cargo build reproduced daemon_binary_sha256. Other final runs used the default build.
traffic_scope: Local peers, trackers and DHT fixtures only; no public bootstrap or trackers. LSD multicast uses TTL/hop limit 1. Transmission public-IP HTTP probes were blocked through a closed loopback proxy.

runs.verified: Trackerless magnets and payload in both directions, shared UDP 6771 with libtorrent started first, LSD counters, peer provenance and SHA-256. The reverse direction resumes the seed to trigger a new announce.

Both LSD-only magnet/transfer directions over IPv6. spill binds a non-default source address on a multi-address interface; libtorrent listens on both the DHCPv6 /128 and SLAAC /64 addresses. Payload SHA-256 matches.

Transmission started first with LPD enabled and DHT/PEX/trackers/mapping disabled. Both trackerless magnet/payload directions completed with matching SHA-256. One multicast packet with 20 Infohash headers produced outbound handshakes for all 20 distinct hashes.
HTTP/UDP trackers, local DHT, PEX, v2/hybrid swarms, aliases and daemon SIGKILL/restart/proof serving.
TCP both directions, magnet catalog/CLI paths, partial SIGKILL/recovery, completed restart, mtime revalidation and payload checksums.

runs.command: python3 tests/interop/transmission_smoke.py --allow-network --host 192.168.1.227 --transport utp --peer-encryption required --transmission-encryption required --size 4MiB --rate-limit 1MiB --artifacts target/interop/lsd-final-transmission-utp
runs.verified: uTP observed in both directions with required RC4 in both clients and matching payload checksums.
Private metainfo over a local HTTP tracker, both transfer directions, restart and changed-file recovery.

found_and_fixed: A specific IPv6 listener announced with the kernel's different preferred IPv6 source. Peers connected to the wrong address and got connection refused. IPV6_PKTINFO now selects the listener address; the final IPv6 matrix passes.
The libtorrent binding exposes v1_only on create_torrent, not create_torrent_flags_t. The LSD harness now uses the supported flag.

Fast transfers and inbound metadata connections invalidated the harness's outbound-only source assertion. Transfers are rate limited for sampling, and provenance/counters now cover inbound and metadata reconnect paths.
observed_limitation: In the IPv6 topology, libtorrent's extended handshake omitted p. Metadata resolved promptly, but payload transfer followed a later inbound retry, about 120 seconds after admission in each format. Checksums and reverse transfers passed; these are correctness checks, not a low-latency claim.
initial_attempt_note: Preserved failed harness checks, the pre-fix IPv6 reproduction and the matrix interrupted for the source-address fix. They are not included as passing final checks.
not_run: multiple physical interfaces and live interface churn
